entities.name: Pentecost (Descent of the Holy Spirit)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Fifty days after Jesus' resurrection, the Holy Spirit descended on the apostles in Jerusalem (Acts 2). Peter preached to assembled crowds, and about 3,000 were baptized. Considered the birthday of the Christian Church.
